# Two meters on one pontoon disagree

**Found by:** the meter reconcile of 2026-08-29.

## Observation

Pontoon C's two meters report a total that is 11% more than the shore meter for the same week. One of them is wrong and the office cannot say which.

## Instance — the east meter, fixed

**Fix:** the east meter's multiplier was set for a 60 A coil and the coil is 100 A; the office corrected the multiplier on 2026-09-01 and the week's total now agrees with the shore meter to within a kilowatt.

## Done means

The office reconciles pontoon meters against the shore meter and names the drift.
